title: SOUND BACK IN BOTH SPEAKERS AFTER A PARTY
why: Found by the whole-game bug hunt of 2026-10-08. In two player co-op on one machine, split speakers (on unless you switch it off) puts player 1 in the left speaker and player 2 in the right. Ending the party never put that back, so after END THE PARTY every sound in that window, guns, footsteps, the ambience and the Undercroft music, came out of one speaker only until the page was reloaded, and the sound rows that could change it only show during a party. Ending the party now puts the sound back in both speakers.
now: After you end a two player party on one machine, sound plays in both speakers again.

edits.anchor: function netSndRelease(){ NET.sndOther=-1; if(NET.sndG){ try{ NET.sndG.gain.value=1; }catch(e){} } return true; }
